title: Chief Financial Officer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Chief Financial Officer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About VelaFi At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States. Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability. Position Overview VelaFi is seeking an experienced Chief Financial Officer (CFO) – Brazil to lead the financial strategy, governance, and regulatory reporting of the company's Brazilian VASP entity. Reporting directly to the Global Finance Leadership Team, the CFO will oversee accounting, treasury, financial planning and analysis (FP&A), tax coordination, regulatory reporting, financial controls, and banking relationships across Brazil. This executive will play a key role in supporting VelaFi's continued expansion by building scalable financial infrastructure, ensuring compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements, and providing strategic financial leadership to the business. The ideal candidate combines deep financial expertise, executive leadership, and experience operating within regulated financial services organizations, with the ability to build scalable processes and support a rapidly growing global fintech company. The CFO will also play a critical role in ensuring compliance with Brazil's financial regulatory reporting framework, including executive oversight of COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, and Unicad (IN BCB 712/713) reporting obligations, while partnering closely with Compliance, Legal, and executive leadership. Location Remote – Brazil Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required. Key Responsibilities Financial Leadership Lead all accounting, finance, treasury, tax, and financial planning activities for the Brazil entity. Develop and execute the company's financial strategy in alignment with global objectives. Establish scalable financial processes, reporting frameworks, and governance standards. Provide financial insights and recommendations to executive leadership. Financial Reporting & Regulatory Compliance Oversee the preparation of accurate financial statements and regulatory reports. Ensure compliance with Brazilian accounting standards, tax requirements, and applicable financial regulations. Lead and oversee all regulatory financial reporting obligations, including COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, and Unicad reporting (IN BCB 712/713), ensuring timely and accurate submissions to BACEN and other applicable regulatory authorities. Support VASP licensing requirements and ongoing regulatory reporting obligations. Coordinate external audits and manage relationships with auditors, the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN), and other regulatory authorities. Maintain strong financial governance while ensuring compliance with evolving regulatory requirements. Treasury & Banking Oversee treasury operations, liquidity management, cash flow forecasting, and banking relationships. Monitor financial performance, capital allocation, and funding requirements. Support payment operations, FX management, and cross-border transaction activities. Partner with Treasury and Operations teams to optimize financial infrastructure. Financial Controls & Risk Management Establish and maintain strong internal controls, accounting policies, and financial governance. Ensure compliance with corporate policies and regulatory requirements. Support enterprise risk management initiatives in partnership with Compliance and Risk leadership. Drive continuous improvement of financial systems and reporting processes. Cross-Functional Leadership Partner closely with Compliance, Operations, Product, Treasury, Legal, Commercial, and Executive Leadership. Support strategic business initiatives, market expansion, and corporate planning. Collaborate with global Finance teams to ensure consistent financial reporting and operational alignment. Organizational Development Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing finance professionals. Build a scalable finance organization capable of supporting rapid business growth. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field. CPA, CRC, or equivalent professional accounting qualification preferred. MBA or advanced finance qualification is a plus. 10+ years of progressive finance leadership experience within fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or related industries. Strong experience leading accounting, treasury, financial reporting, and regulatory compliance functions. Experience working with auditors, regulators, financial institutions, and executive leadership. Strong understanding of Brazilian financial regulations, accounting standards, and tax requirements. Experience preparing or overseeing COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713) reporting, and other regulatory submissions required by Brazilian financial authorities is strongly preferred. Exceptional analytical, leadership, and communication skills. Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English. Desired Competencies Regulatory reporting expertise, including COSIF, SCE-IED, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), and BACEN compliance Nice to Have Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology. Experience with multi-entity and multi-currency financial operations. Experience working with ERP platforms such as NetSuite. Experience supporting regulated financial institutions or VASPs. Knowledge of cross-border payments, FX operations, and treasury infrastructure. Experience working within multinational or global organizations. Hands-on experience with COSIF accounting, SCE-IED reporting, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), and other BACEN regulatory reporting requirements. Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP) Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including: Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil. Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities. Hold any professional registrations or licenses required under Brazilian law to perform the responsibilities of the position, where applicable. Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence. Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws. Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment. Not have been declared bankrupt or legally insolvent. Not have been suspended or prohibited from serving as an executive of regulated financial institutions. Meet any additional "fit and proper" requirements established by the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) and other applicable regulatory authorities. Why Join VelaFi? Joining VelaFi means helping build the next generation of global financial infrastructure. As Chief Financial Officer – Brazil, you will play a foundational role in establishing the financial governance and regulatory reporting framework for one of VelaFi's most strategic international markets. You'll work directly with executive leadership to oversee finance, treasury, regulatory reporting, and compliance while helping build a scalable financial organization that supports the company's long-term growth and Brazil VASP operations. This is an opportunity to shape the financial future of a high-growth fintech company operating at the intersection of traditional finance, digital assets, and cross-border payments. Equal Employment Opportunity VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

This is a technical leadership and team-development role: you'll be the person who trains our paralegals, reviews the team's work, and makes sure every case leaves the office at the firm's standard — across both immigration court (EOIR / removal defense) and affirmative filings before USCIS. We are not an immigration consultancy, and we don't compete with form-fillers. Every case at Cunha Law is handled as a real legal matter — eligibility analysis, case strategy, legal research, and attorney review before anything is filed. We compete with the top U.S. immigration firms, not with the paperwork mills. If that's the standard you want to build a team around, keep reading. This is a role for someone who has real mileage and knows how to develop people. It is not an entry-level position. We're looking for someone with genuine U.S. immigration experience — comfortable both in the dynamics of immigration court and in assembling complex USCIS petitions — with the maturity to lead, train, and hold a team accountable. What you'll do Lead the paralegal team — assign cases, track the caseload, enforce deadlines, and make sure nothing is left loose Train and develop the paralegals on both sides of the practice: affirmative immigration (USCIS) and removal defense (EOIR) Review the team's technical work (QA) — petitions, evidence packages, forms, and letters — before final attorney review Standardize processes, checklists, and SOPs to keep quality and technical consistency high across every case Directly handle and supervise the most complex cases (EOIR + USCIS), serving as the team's reference point Draft and review declarations, memoranda, and responses to RFEs/NOIDs in clear, well-supported legal English Set and enforce an English-first standard across the team's work product and internal communication Report directly to the attorney on caseload status and team development, with disciplined management in Zoho (CRM + Projects) Note: this role is not client-facing. Your focus is the team, technical quality, and training — you work with the team and the attorney, not on the front line with clients. Requirements (the bar is high and it doesn't drop)~5 years of U.S. immigration experience — ideally spanning both immigration court (EOIR) and USCIS petitions, Federal court is highly desirable bonus. Experience leading, training, or supervising paralegals or a technical team (even informally — we want to see that you've developed people and raised a team's standard) Fluent English — written and spoken — is essential and non-negotiable. You'll review and train legal-English work product and set the team's English standard. Spanish is a strong plus — a Spanish-speaker can also take on Spanish-language cases directly, which adds real value to the role. Portuguese is a nice bonus but not required. Command of the core USCIS forms and processes (I-130, I-485, I-765, N-400, I-589, visa petitions) and familiarity with removal-proceeding dynamics Absolute rigor with deadlines, organization, and ownership that doesn't get passed off Able to work 100% remote on U.S. business hours (Washington, DC time zone), following the U.S. calendar What we offer Direct contract, 100% remote from Latin America, in a leadership role Payment in U.S. dollars (USD), monthly — commensurate with experience Real investment in you: training, mentorship, top-tier systems and technology to operate at the level of a first-rate firm A grown-up, respectful, process-driven environment — no micromanagement, with clarity and structure We hire for talent, not pedigree. If you're excellent and bigger firms overlooked you, you're exactly who we want to talk to.

title: Professor De Espanhol
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor De Espanhol em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil! Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares! A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada. Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história. Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT* O que oferecemos? Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Necessário: Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Chief Executive Officer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Chief Executive Officer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About VelaFi At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States. Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability. Position Overview VelaFi is seeking an experienced Chief Executive Officer (CEO) – Brazil to lead the company's Brazilian operations and serve as the statutory executive responsible for the local VASP entity. Reporting directly to the Global Executive Leadership Team, the CEO will be responsible for the overall leadership, strategic direction, regulatory engagement, commercial growth, and operational performance of VelaFi Brazil. This individual will play a critical role in establishing the company's presence in Brazil, leading local market expansion, fostering relationships with regulators and financial institutions, and ensuring compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements. The ideal candidate combines executive leadership experience, strong commercial acumen, operational excellence, and the ability to lead a highly regulated financial services organization in a fast-growing global fintech environment. The CEO will also play a pivotal role in leading VelaFi Brazil's regulatory establishment, including executive oversight of the BACEN registration process and collaboration on the company's Brazil VASP licensing process, working closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership. Location Remote – Brazil Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required. Key Responsibilities Executive Leadership Lead the overall strategy, growth, and operational performance of VelaFi Brazil. Build and develop the local leadership team and organizational structure. Establish operational excellence while ensuring alignment with global company objectives. Drive execution across Commercial, Operations, Finance, Compliance, and Product functions. Regulatory & Corporate Governance Serve as the primary executive representative before Brazilian regulatory authorities. Maintain strong relationships with the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN), financial institutions, banking partners, and other regulatory stakeholders. Lead the company's BACEN registration process, ensuring timely execution of regulatory requirements and coordination with internal and external stakeholders. Provide executive oversight and collaborate closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership throughout the Brazil VASP licensing process, supporting regulatory submissions, licensing milestones, and ongoing compliance efforts. Ensure ongoing compliance with applicable VASP, financial services, and corporate governance requirements. Support ongoing regulatory reporting, licensing renewals, and corporate governance initiatives. Commercial Growth & Strategic Partnerships Develop and execute the company's go-to-market strategy in Brazil. Build strategic partnerships with banks, payment service providers (PSPs), fintechs, enterprise customers, and ecosystem partners. Identify new business opportunities and support revenue growth. Represent VelaFi at executive meetings, conferences, and industry events. Cross-Functional Leadership Partner closely with Finance, Compliance, Treasury, Product, Operations, Legal, and Commercial teams. Foster collaboration across global teams located in LATAM, APAC, and North America. Drive organizational alignment and operational efficiency across all business functions. Organizational Development Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing teams. Promote a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Support workforce planning and organizational scaling as the business grows. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Law, or a related field. MBA or other advanced degree preferred. 10+ years of executive leadership experience within fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or related industries. Proven experience leading business operations and organizational growth. Strong understanding of Brazil's financial services and regulatory environment. Experience working with regulators, banking institutions, and executive stakeholders. Experience leading or supporting regulatory licensing, authorization, or registration processes with Brazilian financial regulators (including BACEN or VASP frameworks) is strongly preferred. Exceptional leadership, communication, and decision-making skills. Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English. Nice to Have Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology. Experience launching or scaling financial services businesses in Brazil. Existing relationships with Brazilian regulators, financial institutions, and payment providers. Experience working within multinational or global organizations. Experience with cross-border payments and treasury infrastructure. Experience leading or supporting BACEN registration, financial institution licensing, or Brazil VASP authorization initiatives. Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP) Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including: Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil. Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities. Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence. Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws. Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment. Why Join VelaFi? At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we connect local banking rails, global payment networks, and digital asset infrastructure to enable faster, more secure, and more efficient cross-border money movement. Joining VelaFi means playing a foundational leadership role in establishing our regulated presence in Brazil while helping shape one of the company's most strategic growth markets. You'll work alongside global executive leadership to build a scalable business, lead critical regulatory initiatives, and help create the financial infrastructure powering the next generation of global payments. Guided by our values of Ingenuity, Accountability, Excellence, Care, and a Global Mindset, we empower our leaders to solve meaningful challenges, take ownership, and build lasting impact across global financial markets. Equal Employment Opportunity VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Presales Solution Architect, Oss
description:

Responsibilities: Act as the lead OSS solution architect across the full pre-sales lifecycle – from opportunity qualification and technical discovery through proof-of-concept, proposal, and contract award – partnering closely with Sales leadership to shape, qualify, and grow the regional pipeline. Own and orchestrate end-to-end responses to RFx (RFI / RFP / RFQ), including solution design, compliance and traceability matrices, win themes, technical narratives, effort and Bill-of-Materials estimation, assumptions, and risk identification – driving on-time, high-quality, fully compliant submissions. Design and articulate end-to-end OSS solution architectures spanning Service Assurance, Service Orchestration & Fulfilment, Inventory, and closed-loop automation, mapping the Rakuten Symphony portfolio to operator pain points and measurable business outcomes. Position and demonstrate the Service Assurance portfolio – fault, performance, and service-quality management;
AI/ML-driven anomaly detection, alarm correlation and noise reduction;
automated root-cause analysis;
and predictive, proactive assurance – including customer-experience and network-slice assurance for 5G Standalone. Develop solutions, value cases, and demonstrations around SMO (Service Management & Orchestration) and RIC (RAN Intelligent Controller) platforms, including the Non-RT RIC and rApps (R1, A1 interfaces) and the Near-RT RIC and xApps (E2 interface), addressing use cases such as RAN energy savings, traffic steering, QoE optimization, massive-MIMO and interference management, and anomaly detection. Champion network automation and autonomy – closed-loop operations, intent-based and intent-driven management, and the journey toward TM Forum Level 4 autonomous networks – and translate these capabilities into concrete, quantifiable value propositions for customers. Lead technical proofs-of-concept, lab trials, product demonstrations, and solution integration and validation, tailoring demo environments to each customer’s specific use cases, KPIs, and success criteria. Be responsible and accountable for authoring technical solution documents, high-level designs, design proposals, sizing and Bill-of-Materials, and TCO / ROI models that withstand customer and third-party technical scrutiny. Serve as the trusted technical advisor to customers and prospects – running discovery workshops, executive briefings, and technical deep-dives – and manage technical stakeholder relationships from engineering and operations teams up to C-level. Work cross-functionally with internal teams – Product Management, Engineering, Delivery / Professional Services, Commercial, and Bid Management – and with external parties – operators, system integrators, hyperscalers, and O-RAN / ecosystem partners – to assemble winning and deliverable solutions. Generate thought-leadership content – white papers, blogs, reference architectures, and webinars – and represent Rakuten Symphony at industry events and standards / community forums such as TM Forum and the O-RAN ALLIANCE. Stay ahead of telecom market trends – Open RAN, 5G and 5G-Advanced, cloud-native CNFs and Kubernetes, observability and telemetry, GenAI and agentic AI for operations, and the shift toward data-driven, autonomous networks – and bring that insight into customer conversations and internal strategy. Requirements: Must-have demonstrable skills & expertise: Exceptional verbal and written communication, executive presentation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value. Proven hands-on pre-sales and solution-architecture experience in the OSS domain for mobile operators and/or telecommunication vendors, including ownership of RFx responses and customer-facing technical engagements. Deep, demonstrable expertise across the Service Assurance domain – fault, performance, and service-quality management, customer-experience management, and AI/ML-driven assurance (anomaly detection, correlation, automated root-cause analysis, and predictive / proactive assurance). Strong working knowledge of network automation and autonomy – closed-loop assurance and orchestration, intent-based operations, and the TM Forum Autonomous Networks framework (Levels 0–5). Familiarity with O-RAN architecture and SMO / RIC platforms, including the Non-RT RIC (rApps, R1, A1), the Near-RT RIC (xApps, E2), and the O1 / O2 management interfaces. Exposure to public clouds (GCP, Azure, and AWS) and to cloud service models (IaaS, PaaS, DBaaS), with an appreciation of hybrid / multi-cloud and O-Cloud deployment models. Working knowledge of TM Forum standards and Open APIs / Open Digital Architecture (ODA), and of data and observability technologies (streaming pipelines, telemetry, and data lakes). Demonstrated ability to lead and coordinate virtual, cross-functional bid and solution teams across multiple geographies and time zones, and to manage internal and external stakeholders. Willingness to travel as required.

title: Head Of Risk (Crypto)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head Of Risk (Crypto) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Head of Risk (Crypto) (Brazil-based) About the Company: We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet — and we're looking for exceptional finance professionals to help shape it. The Role: We are in search of a business-oriented Head of Risk (Crypto) to lead the overall risk management function for our Brazil entity. This role focuses on end-to-end risk management across trading, financial crime, and product risk, while ensuring the company operates within its defined risk appetite while actively supporting business growth. Unlike traditional compliance-heavy roles, this position is about risk ownership: identifying exposures, calibrating tolerance, and driving real-time control execution. We're looking for someone who understands that well-designed risk frameworks are a business enabler, not a brake. We welcome candidates with a strong crypto or digital asset background. We are equally open to risk leaders from traditional financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, or payments companies who bring deep, transferable expertise and a genuine appetite to operate in a more dynamic, high-growth environment. What You'll Do: Establish and lead the company's enterprise-wide risk management framework, covering trading and market risk, product risk, financial crime risk, and operational risk. Define, review, and continuously optimise the risk appetite framework in alignment with overall business strategy. Monitor risk activities to ensure alignment with internal risk policies, business objectives, and applicable Brazilian regulatory expectations, and other relevant regulatory authorities. Partner with senior leadership and the Board to embed risk-informed thinking into strategic decision-making. Build and enhance risk control mechanisms across transaction monitoring and risk indicators, market surveillance controls, and product risk assessment frameworks. Identify and stay ahead of emerging risks in trading, product design, and operations, and lead mitigation strategies. Strengthen internal control systems and drive effective risk governance across the organisation. Support the company's ongoing regulatory engagement and risk governance as Brazil's digital asset regulatory framework continues to evolve. What We're Looking For: 10+ years of risk management experience within crypto, financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, payments, or digital asset businesses. Deep expertise in enterprise risk management, including risk appetite frameworks, governance, and internal controls. Strong understanding of trading, transaction, and financial crime risks, with the ability to balance effective risk management against commercial objectives. Ability to translate risk frameworks into practical controls and work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Operations to implement them. Proven track record operating at or reporting to Executive Committee and Board level. Strategic thinker with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and embed a strong risk culture across the organisation spanning across operational, market and liquidity risk. Expert understanding of Brazilian regulatory expectations relating to financial institutions and digital asset service providers. Crypto or digital asset experience is strongly preferred, but we also welcome candidates from traditional financial services with strong transferable risk expertise and a genuine interest in the digital asset sector. Functional knowledge of digital asset or digital token listing processes is preferred.

description:

PROPOSTA EXECUTIVA: YUMMI Status do Projeto: 100% Concluído e Pronto para Rodar O Cenário Atual Muitas startups buscam investimento para tentar construir uma ideia. Nós fizemos o oposto. A Yummi já superou a fase mais arriscada de um negócio de tecnologia. O software está totalmente desenvolvido, testado e validado. Buscamos um parceiro estratégico e financeiro focado exclusivamente em colocar o produto no mercado e acelerar a atração de clientes. O Problema do Mercado Atualmente, os donos de estabelecimentos vivem um caos operacional. Eles sofrem com a fragmentação, precisando contratar, pagar e gerenciar de três a cinco sistemas diferentes para rodar o negócio, como frente de caixa, delivery, financeiro e cardápio digital. Para piorar, as ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial genéricas do mercado falham, erram pedidos em horários de pico e causam prejuízo. A Solução Yummi A Yummi elimina essa bagunça unificando todas as funções essenciais em uma única plataforma centralizada, intuitiva e robusta. Nós corrigimos as falhas das tecnologias comuns, aplicando uma Inteligência Artificial lapidada e integrada de forma nativa. O comerciante elimina custos com múltiplos softwares, reduz despesas fixas e gerencia o negócio inteiro com um único login. Risco Zero de Desenvolvimento O maior medo de um investidor em tecnologia é o atraso ou o fracasso no desenvolvimento do software. Na Yummi, esse risco não existe. O produto mínimo viável está cem por cento concluído e funcional. A infraestrutura está pronta e testada para suportar alta demanda de acessos. Nosso foco atual é zero por cento em programação e cem por cento em marketing e vendas. Destinação do Capital e Custos Base Todo o capital aportado será direcionado estrategicamente para gerar tração imediata e receita. Oitenta por cento (80%) do recurso será aplicado diretamente em Marketing e Aquisição de Novos Clientes, utilizando estratégias agressivas de tráfego pago no Google e Meta Ads, ações locais e canais comerciais para acelerar a entrada de novos usuários na plataforma. Os vinte por cento (20%) restantes serão mantidos como Contingência e Operação, garantindo a estabilidade absoluta de servidores como AWS ou Firebase e o suporte técnico inicial para que os novos clientes tenham uma experiência impecável. Por que a Yummi é um Investimento Confiável? Como a Yummi centraliza toda a operação do cliente, o custo de mudança para ele é muito alto, o que garante uma taxa de cancelamento extremamente baixa e retenção prolongada. Além disso, o modelo é altamente escalável: os custos de servidor são previsíveis e, conforme a base de clientes cresce, a margem de lucro líquido aumenta exponencialmente. Oferecemos total transparência, com relatórios mensais detalhados de crescimento, usuários ativos e faturamento. O motor já está construído e ligado. Só precisamos do combustível para o marketing.

title: Ad Designer
description:

Ad Designer (Performance Creative + Video Editor) Location: Remote (Able to accommodate CST time) Reports To: Marketing Director Type : Full-Time About Carepod Carepod is a premium humidifier brand originally designed in Korea, known for our stainless steel water tanks, filter-free system, and elevated design. We operate across US, Canada, and Australia, with strong seasonal performance in Q4 and continued growth year over year. We are entering our next stage of growth and are looking for a performance-driven Ad Designer to help scale our creative engine. Role Overview We are looking for a highly skilled Ad Designer who can both design and video edit performance-driven creative for paid media channels. This role is responsible for turning strategy into high-converting visual assets across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging platforms. You will work closely with our Marketing team to test, iterate, and scale creative that drives revenue — while emphasizing our premium brand positioning. Key Responsibilities Performance Creative Development Design static and motion ad creatives for Meta, TikTok, and other paid platforms Develop multiple creative variations per concept (hooks, angles, CTAs, layouts) Execute rapid testing cycles based on performance data Translate growth briefs into high-quality, on-brand ad assets Develop creative aligned to seasonal campaigns Video Editing & Motion Create short-form video ads (9:16, 1:1, 4:5, 16:9 formats) Edit UGC into performance-optimized paid ads Add captions, motion graphics, overlays, callouts, and performance hooks Optimize pacing and retention for the first 3–5 seconds Re-cut and repackage winning content into multiple variants Incorporate voiceover, testimonial layering, and sound design where needed Performance & Iteration Review performance metrics weekly with Growth team Identify winning hooks, formats, angles, and messaging Produce new variants based on data (not just aesthetics) Help build a scalable creative testing system Maintain an organized creative library with tags by angle, hook, and performance 🧠 Creative Strategy Collaboration Collaborate with Marketing team on creative briefs Repurpose UGC into paid formats Support product launches with creative concept development Contribute to creative ideation sessions Required Skills & Experience 3–5+ years in performance-focused creative design Strong portfolio of paid social and digital ad creative Strong understanding of Meta ad formats Advanced proficiency in: Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects) CapCut / similar short-form editing tools Experience designing for DTC brands (premium preferred) Ability to balance brand integrity with performance urgency Strong organizational skills Comfortable with fast iteration cycles What Makes You Exceptional You understand the difference between brand creative and performance creative. You know how to design urgency without feeling “cheap.” You can turn one piece of UGC into 10 different ad variations. You think in hooks and testing frameworks. You care about typography, layout, and visual hierarchy. You move quickly but thoughtfully. Why This Role Matters At our stage, creative is the lever. Media buying is only as strong as the creative behind it. This role directly impacts revenue growth, efficiency, and scalability. You will play a central role in helping Carepod reach our next major milestone. How to apply Please submit your resume in English as part of your application.

description:

Role Overview We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution. The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes. Key Responsibilities Business Development & Partnerships Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered) Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms) Market & Network Development Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa) Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape Execution & Collaboration Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships Banking & Infrastructure Setup Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement Requirements 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Travel Buddies Wir sind ein Team, das in den Destinationen lebt, die wir verkaufen. Unsere Buddies in Kuba, Vietnam und Namibia planen jede Reise selbst und betreuen die Gäste vor Ort. Jetzt bauen wir Brasilien auf. Du wärst die erste Person dafür. Was du machst Du lebst in Brasilien und kennst das Land aus deinem Alltag, deinen Freundschaften, deiner Arbeit. Du hast zwei Aufgaben bei uns: Du sprichst mit deutschsprachigen Reisenden, die bei uns einen Beratungstermin gebucht haben. Du verstehst, was sie wollen, und planst mit uns gemeinsam ihre Reise — Routen, Unterkünfte, Erlebnisse. Du bist die Stimme aus Brasilien, wir bauen das Angebot daraus. Wenn deine Gäste in Brasilien ankommen, bist du ihr Ansprechpartner. Per WhatsApp, im Call, manchmal persönlich. Du löst Probleme, wenn der Inlandsflug nach Salvador gestrichen wird oder die Pousada überbucht ist. Du organisierst Begegnungen, die im Reiseführer nicht stehen — die Köchin für deine Moqueca, den Jangadeiro mit seinem Segelfloß im Nordosten, den Musiker in der Roda de Samba, den Capoeira-Lehrer, den du persönlich kennst. Du arbeitest 1:1 mit deinen Gästen. Dein Job ist, sie über dein Netzwerk und deine Geschichte mit dem Land zu verbinden. Was du mitbringen musst Du lebst seit mehreren Jahren in Brasilien. Mit Alltag, Freundeskreis, festen Strukturen. Deutsch auf Muttersprache- oder C1-Niveau. Die Beratung läuft auf Deutsch. Du hast eine eigene Geschichte mit dem Land. Warum bist du gekommen, was hält dich. Du arbeitest selbstständig und bist gut erreichbar — per WhatsApp und im Video-Call. Was zusätzlich hilft Portugiesisch-Kenntnisse Englisch fließend Erfahrung in Tourismus, Hospitality oder Beratung Ein eigenes Netzwerk an Hotels, Pousadas, Drivern, Köchen Vertrautheit mit CRM, Google Workspace, WhatsApp Business Zugang zu Menschen, die einen Gast persönlich beeindrucken: Köche, Musiker, Fischer, Capoeira-Lehrer, Flussbootskapitäne im Amazonas Was wir bieten Freelance-Vertrag mit flexiblen Stunden. Als Nebentätigkeit gedacht für jemanden, der ohnehin im Land lebt. Vergütung auf Stundenbasis plus Boni für Buchungen und gute Bewertungen. Du baust eine Destination von null auf und prägst, wie wir Brasilien machen. Ein eingespieltes Team im Rücken: Buchungen, Verträge, Tools, Versicherung. Du machst das, was nur du kannst. Langfristige Zusammenarbeit über Jahre. Eine Frage in deiner Bewerbung: Welchen Ort oder welche Begegnung in Brasilien könntest du möglich machen, die ein Tourist allein nie findet?

title: Engenheiro De Ia Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro De Ia Sênior em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior para assumir a manutenção e a evolução contínua do Plataforma Agents de IA — nosso framework de orquestração de agentes de IA que automatiza ciclos completos de desenvolvimento de software (refinement → dev →security → QA → deploy) em nossos projetos reais, em produção. Esta não é uma vaga de "treinar modelo" nem de "fazer prompt em chatbot". E engenharia de plataforma com foco em confiabilidade, observabilidade e auto-recuperação de agentes autônomos rodando 24/7 em produção, escrevendo código de desenvolvimento, fazendo git push, abrindo PRs, mergeando em omolog, fazendo cherry-pick para produção. O que é o Plataforma Agents de IA Para você decidir se a vaga te interessa, precisa entender o que vai manter: - Orquestrador: Le as issues (Jira), identifica issues prontas pra cada stage, dispara agentes (Claude/OpenIA/Gemini/DeepSeek) com contexto rico, valida o resultado, posta comentario na issue, e avanca o status. Roda em servidores Linux, com auto-update.
- Agentes (@dev, @qa, @sec, @devops, @pm, @po, @sm, @analyst, @architect, @data-engineer, @ux-design-expert): cada um com persona, authority matrix definida, skills executáveis e Gates de qualidade.
- Rules: Mais de 60 regras formais que governam o comportamento dos agentes — desde naming conventions até anti-hallucination validation em 7 camadas. Cada rule nasce de um bug real anonimizado em produção e tem detector regex + caso aplicação por agent.
- Recovery loops: quando um stage falha (CI quebra, conflict de cherry-pick, working tree dirty, autocompact thrashing), o orquestrador detecta deterministicamente e redispara o agente em --mode=ci_recovery com contexto enriquecido. Cap de tentativas, anti-oscilação, escalada pra humano quando esgota.
- Multi-repo via submodules: projetos clientes tem 2 a 30+ sub-repos. Vertex orquestra cherry-pick coordenado, dependency promotion cross-issue, working-tree auto-recovery, validação de paridade de coverage Sonar.
- Stack: Bash 5+ (nucleo), Python, Node.Js/TypeScript (CLIs auxiliares), gh CLI, jq, integrações com Jira/GitHub via curl + retry policy. O que você vai fazer Manutenção do core (40%)- Manter e evoluir fix de bugs, refatorações controladas, redução de complexidade ciclomática.
- Garantir que retry policies (Git, PM API, autocompact, recovery loops) continuem determinísticas e sem custo desnecessário.
- Manter as integrações com Jira API (ADF, webhooks, transitions, comments via helper canônico) funcionais frente a mudancas de schema/comportamento.
- Operar e melhorar o sistema de telemetria (dashboards de custo por agent/stage/issue).
- Diagnosticar incidentes em produção (cliente reporta "agent crashou em loop", "PR criado no repo errado", "deploy não promoveu") e fechar com case study anonimizado + nova rule preventiva. Evolução de agents e rules (35%)- Criar e refinar rules quando bugs sistemicos forem detectados — cada rule nova segue o template canônico (detector regex, aplicação por agent, caso real anonimizado, antipatterns, checklist).
- Calibrar prompts dos agents para reduzir alucinação, scope creep, falsos positivos e ciclos de retrabalho.
- Manter o agent-authority.Md consistente quando authorities mudarem (ex: @dev ganhou ownership de PR contra homolog em v2.0.146).
- Criar/refatorar skills.
- Medir impacto de cada rule nova (redução de ciclos de retrabalho, custo USD por issue, leakage rate de bugs Categoria A vs B). Integrações com LLM CLIs (25%)- Manter compatibilidade com mudanças de breaking change dos provedores (Claude Code, OpenAI CLI, Gemini CLI, DeepSeek direct).
- Avaliar e integrar novos providers/modelos quando custo-benefício mudar (ex: DeepSeek-Reasoner para recovery loops, Haiku para classificação).
- Otimizar custo: identificar stages onde modelo menor resolve.
- Implementar fallbacks quando um provider está em outage (ja existe retry transient;
expandir cobertura).
- Trabalhar com tokenização, context windows, autocompact thrashing detection — entender as falhas reais de cada modelo, não a teoria. O que esperamos de você Stack técnica — obrigatório - Bash/Shell avançado e Linux — você e confortável lendo e escrevendo 500+ linhas de bash com set -euo pipefail, traps, subshells, file locks, jq, awk, sed, heredocs, parameter expansion avançada. Não tem medo de poll.Sh. Sabe diferenciar ( ) de (( e porque importa.
- Node.Js / TypeScript — escreve TS com strict mode, entende quando não usar Node (ex: lógica de orquestração crítica fica em bash justamente porque e mais previsível que async JS).
- Git e GitHub avançado — cherry-pick com -m 1, submodules, gh pr create/merge/edit/list --search, git revert, git rebase --autosquash, resolução de conflicts nao-triviais, branch protection rules, GitHub Actions workflows.
- Prompt engineering aplicado a agentes autônomos — você já calibrou prompts em produção, sabe que "diga ao modelo o que não fazer" raramente funciona, entende o efeito de exemplos few-shot vs zero-shot, e já debugou ao menos uma vez porque um agente está "alucinando" um PR que não criou. Experiência - 5+ anos de engenharia de software produzindo sistemas em produção.
- Pelo menos 1 ano com agentes autônomos / orquestração de LLMs em ambiente real (não bootcamp, não side project) — você sabe a diferença entre "rodou no demo" e "rodou em prod 24/7 sem humano".
- Histórico comprovado de manter sistemas legados com debt técnico — você não quer "reescrever do zero".
- Inglês técnico fluente para leitura/escrita (documentação, issues, comentários de código em inglês obrigatórios;
comunicação verbal podeser PT/EN/ZH dependendo do time). Mentalidade - Determinismo >
magia. Você prefere umaregex feia em bash que sempre funciona a um ML model elegante que falha em 5% dos casos. Em orquestração de agentes, 5% de falha = produto inviável.
- Forensics sobre intuição. Antes de propor solução, você lê o log, o diff, a issue real do cliente. Não inventa hipótese.
- Documentação executável. Quando você cria uma rule nova, ela tem detector regex que pode rodar em CI. "Documentei em texto" não basta.
- Empatia por agente. Você consegue ler um prompt de 8k tokens e identificar onde o modelo vai se confundir, por que, e o que ajustar. Diferenciais - Experiencia com Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph ou frameworks de orquestração equivalentes.
- Já implementou ou manteve sistemas de retry policy + backoff exponencial + circuit breaker em integrações com APIs externas instáveis.
- Já trabalhou com monorepos via submodules (nao apenas Nx/Turborepo) e entende os trade-offs.

When you spot a merchant at risk or an opening to grow, you'll route that signal to the right account owner fast. Why this role matters: Storefront optimization is no longer a "nice-to-have";
it's becoming table stakes for ecommerce success. Merchants are trusting Shoplift with decisions that directly move their revenue, and every support interaction either reinforces or erodes that trust. Support isn't a cost center here. It's a direct input to retention, satisfaction, and growth, and you're on the front line of it. Responsibilities: Support delivery: Own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls. Diagnose accurately, respond with empathy and clarity, and see each case through to a confident close. Escalate complex, high-impact, or time-sensitive issues to the Support Team Lead promptly and with clear, complete context so nothing stalls in handoff. Service quality and consistency: Ensure every response reflects Shoplift's standards for accuracy, tone, and helpfulness. Use support macros correctly and flag any that are outdated or misaligned with current product behavior so they can be corrected quickly. Deliver the consistency merchants expect regardless of who picks up their ticket. Product and platform expertise: Maintain deep, current knowledge of how A/B testing, experiment setup, and CRO workflows function for merchants day to day, and understand enough of the underlying Shopify environment to reason about issues in context. Product fluency is what separates a good answer from a resolution that actually moves the merchant forward. Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Product and Engineering by reproducing issues cleanly, documenting them clearly, and surfacing recurring patterns that point to deeper fixes. Meet support SLA targets across priority levels and keep tickets moving on the "waiting on us" side of any dependency. Retention and expansion signal: Recognize retention risk and expansion opportunity in the course of support conversations, and route those signals quickly and accurately to the relevant CSM or account owner. Reinforce merchant trust and satisfaction in every interaction. Continuous improvement: Strengthen self-serve and AI-enabled support by identifying gaps in documentation, macros, and help content, and recommend improvements to tools, training, and enablement based on what you see in the queue. Support the ramp of new teammates by sharing knowledge and modeling the service standard What We're Looking For: Must-haves: Shopify ecosystem experience. You've worked in or around the Shopify platform and understand how merchants operate within it, including apps, themes, and the merchant admin. You can speak a merchant's language from day one. Direct-to-consumer fluency. You understand the DTC and ecommerce world, how online brands think about conversion and growth, and the pressures merchants face. This context lets you prioritize correctly and respond with credibility. Proven front-line support experience delivering high-quality service across chat, email, and phone. Strong verbal and written proficiency with English, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically to non-technical merchants. Strong diagnostic instincts and a bias toward full resolution over deflection. Comfort working at pace in a high-growth environment where processes are still being built. Nice-to-haves: Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation, or conversion rate optimization (CRO). Prior experience supporting a SaaS or B2B software product. Experience with support tooling such as ticketing systems, macros, and AI-assisted support workflows. Light technical exposure (HTML/CSS, JavaScript) or familiarity with analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GA4, Segment).

Reporting directly to the Global Executive Leadership Team, the CEO will be responsible for the overall leadership, strategic direction, regulatory engagement, commercial growth, and operational performance of VelaFi Brazil. This individual will play a critical role in establishing the company's presence in Brazil, leading local market expansion, fostering relationships with regulators and financial institutions, and ensuring compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements. The ideal candidate combines executive leadership experience, strong commercial acumen, operational excellence, and the ability to lead a highly regulated financial services organization in a fast-growing global fintech environment. The CEO will also play a pivotal role in leading VelaFi Brazil's regulatory establishment, including executive oversight of the BACEN registration process and collaboration on the company's Brazil VASP licensing process, working closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership. Location Remote – Brazil Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required. Key Responsibilities Executive Leadership Lead the overall strategy, growth, and operational performance of VelaFi Brazil. Build and develop the local leadership team and organizational structure. Establish operational excellence while ensuring alignment with global company objectives. Drive execution across Commercial, Operations, Finance, Compliance, and Product functions. Maintain strong relationships with the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN), financial institutions, banking partners, and other regulatory stakeholders. Lead the company's BACEN registration process, ensuring timely execution of regulatory requirements and coordination with internal and external stakeholders. Provide executive oversight and collaborate closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership throughout the Brazil VASP licensing process, supporting regulatory submissions, licensing milestones, and ongoing compliance efforts. Ensure ongoing compliance with applicable VASP, financial services, and corporate governance requirements. Support ongoing regulatory reporting, licensing renewals, and corporate governance initiatives. Commercial Growth & Strategic Partnerships Develop and execute the company's go-to-market strategy in Brazil. Build strategic partnerships with banks, payment service providers (PSPs), fintechs, enterprise customers, and ecosystem partners. Identify new business opportunities and support revenue growth. Represent VelaFi at executive meetings, conferences, and industry events. Cross-Functional Leadership Partner closely with Finance, Compliance, Treasury, Product, Operations, Legal, and Commercial teams. Foster collaboration across global teams located in LATAM, APAC, and North America. Drive organizational alignment and operational efficiency across all business functions. Organizational Development Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing teams. Promote a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Support workforce planning and organizational scaling as the business grows. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Law, or a related field. MBA or other advanced degree preferred. 10+ years of executive leadership experience within fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or related industries. Proven experience leading business operations and organizational growth. Strong understanding of Brazil's financial services and regulatory environment. Experience working with regulators, banking institutions, and executive stakeholders. Experience leading or supporting regulatory licensing, authorization, or registration processes with Brazilian financial regulators (including BACEN or VASP frameworks) is strongly preferred. Exceptional leadership, communication, and decision-making skills. Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English. Nice to Have Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology. Experience launching or scaling financial services businesses in Brazil. Existing relationships with Brazilian regulators, financial institutions, and payment providers. Experience working within multinational or global organizations. Experience with cross-border payments and treasury infrastructure. Experience leading or supporting BACEN registration, financial institution licensing, or Brazil VASP authorization initiatives. Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP) Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including: Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil. Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities. Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence. Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws. Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment. Why Join VelaFi? At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we connect local banking rails, global payment networks, and digital asset infrastructure to enable faster, more secure, and more efficient cross-border money movement. Joining VelaFi means playing a foundational leadership role in establishing our regulated presence in Brazil while helping shape one of the company's most strategic growth markets. You'll work alongside global executive leadership to build a scalable business, lead critical regulatory initiatives, and help create the financial infrastructure powering the next generation of global payments. Guided by our values of Ingenuity, Accountability, Excellence, Care, and a Global Mindset, we empower our leaders to solve meaningful challenges, take ownership, and build lasting impact across global financial markets. Equal Employment Opportunity VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Tech Lead
description:

About Flamus Every creation starts with something internal. An idea, a need, something that wants to exist. But nothing grows alone. It needs space. It needs people. Flamus exists in that moment. This is not about maintaining a system. It's about shaping one. What You'll Own The technical direction across services, web, and infrastructure Architectural decisions across a multi-service, multi-repo system The standards for how we write, test, and ship code The evolution of our backend, real-time systems, and data layer You won't just contribute to the system. You will define how it evolves. Core Stack We work with a modern, performance-oriented stack: Runtime: Bun + TypeScript Frontend: Next.Js (App Router, Server Components) Backend: ElysiaJS + Eden Treaty (end-to-end type safety) Database: PostgreSQL (Neon) + Drizzle ORM Cache & Real-time: Redis (queues, streams, presence) Auth: Better-Auth (roles, sessions, KYC) Architecture & Systems Microservices architecture across file, discovery, chat, notify, fiat, and more Monorepo with Git submodules and independent versioning Real-time systems (chat, presence, streams) Media pipelines (upload, processing, streaming) Cloud & Infrastructure AWS with Infrastructure as Code (CDK) EC2, Amplify, and supporting services Docker for local environments CI/CD with GitHub Actions (dev → staging → main) Secrets management (1Password → GitHub) Observability with OpenTelemetry + Axiom Engineering Quality Strong testing culture (unit with Bun, E2E with Playwright) Code quality via Biome and CI gates Consistent commit conventions and workflows Who You Are You have led technical architecture across complex systems You are fluent in TypeScript and care deeply about type safety You are comfortable working across backend, frontend, and infrastructure You think in systems, not isolated services You are hands-on and still enjoy writing code You mentor engineers and raise the quality bar of the team Nice to Have Experience with Bun or high-performance runtimes Experience with real-time systems and event-driven architectures Familiarity with Rust (desktop / Tauri context) Experience with creator platforms, monetization, or payments Experience with internationalized products How You'll Lead Define architectural standards across repositories Review and guide technical decisions across teams Mentor engineers with a focus on performance and type safety Coordinate releases and system evolution How We Work People come first. You'll have autonomy to define direction, real proximity to product and decision-making, and a team that builds together. This is a place for people who care about what they build. Format Remote · Contract-based

Your Role: As a Customer Support Representative at Shoplift, you'll be the daily face of Shoplift to thousands of merchants. You'll own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls, diagnosing problems accurately, responding with empathy and clarity, and seeing every case through to a confident close. You're the first person a merchant turns to when something isn't working, and the quality of that moment shapes how they feel about the entire platform. You'll do more than close tickets. You'll build real product and platform expertise, recognize the patterns behind recurring issues, and feed what you learn back to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success so the whole experience gets better. When you spot a merchant at risk or an opening to grow, you'll route that signal to the right account owner fast. Why this role matters: Storefront optimization is no longer a "nice-to-have";
it's becoming table stakes for ecommerce success. Merchants are trusting Shoplift with decisions that directly move their revenue, and every support interaction either reinforces or erodes that trust. Support isn't a cost center here. It's a direct input to retention, satisfaction, and growth, and you're on the front line of it. Responsibilities: Support delivery: Own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls. Diagnose accurately, respond with empathy and clarity, and see each case through to a confident close. Escalate complex, high-impact, or time-sensitive issues to the Support Team Lead promptly and with clear, complete context so nothing stalls in handoff. Service quality and consistency: Ensure every response reflects Shoplift's standards for accuracy, tone, and helpfulness. Use support macros correctly and flag any that are outdated or misaligned with current product behavior so they can be corrected quickly. Deliver the consistency merchants expect regardless of who picks up their ticket. Product and platform expertise: Maintain deep, current knowledge of how A/B testing, experiment setup, and CRO workflows function for merchants day to day, and understand enough of the underlying Shopify environment to reason about issues in context. Product fluency is what separates a good answer from a resolution that actually moves the merchant forward. Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Product and Engineering by reproducing issues cleanly, documenting them clearly, and surfacing recurring patterns that point to deeper fixes. Meet support SLA targets across priority levels and keep tickets moving on the "waiting on us" side of any dependency. Retention and expansion signal: Recognize retention risk and expansion opportunity in the course of support conversations, and route those signals quickly and accurately to the relevant CSM or account owner. Reinforce merchant trust and satisfaction in every interaction. Continuous improvement: Strengthen self-serve and AI-enabled support by identifying gaps in documentation, macros, and help content, and recommend improvements to tools, training, and enablement based on what you see in the queue. Support the ramp of new teammates by sharing knowledge and modeling the service standard What We're Looking For: Must-haves: Shopify ecosystem experience. You've worked in or around the Shopify platform and understand how merchants operate within it, including apps, themes, and the merchant admin. You can speak a merchant's language from day one. Direct-to-consumer fluency. You understand the DTC and ecommerce world, how online brands think about conversion and growth, and the pressures merchants face. This context lets you prioritize correctly and respond with credibility. Proven front-line support experience delivering high-quality service across chat, email, and phone. Strong verbal and written proficiency with English, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically to non-technical merchants. Strong diagnostic instincts and a bias toward full resolution over deflection. Comfort working at pace in a high-growth environment where processes are still being built. Nice-to-haves: Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation, or conversion rate optimization (CRO). Prior experience supporting a SaaS or B2B software product. Experience with support tooling such as ticketing systems, macros, and AI-assisted support workflows. Light technical exposure (HTML/CSS, JavaScript) or familiarity with analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GA4, Segment).

From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens. At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact. Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide. Role Overview As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives. Key Responsibilities 1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval. 2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration. 3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble 4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback. Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions. 5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines. 6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards. 7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows. 8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology 9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content. 10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible. Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements. Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork. Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis. Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Production Support & Governance - Act as escalation point for production issues, SLA adherence, root cause analysis, and resolution.
- Ensure strong governance around transports (ChaRM), releases, incident/change management, and documentation. Team & Stakeholder Leadership: - Mentor and guide SAP BW developers and HANA modelers.
- Work closely with business stakeholders, functional teams, architects, and program managers.
- Contribute to effort estimation, planning, and delivery commitments.

Bancos de Dados (Oracle e PostgreSQL): Capacidade para analisar modelos relacionais, otimizar queries complexas e realizar integrações eficientes entre as aplicações C/C++ e as camadas de dados. Gestão Técnica de Incidentes Críticos (P0/P1): Liderança técnica na resposta a crises, isolamento de falhas em ambiente produtivo Linux e definição de contornos (workarounds) ágeis para garantir a disponibilidade do sistema.
