Soft Skills: Liderança Técnica e Mentoria: Capacidade de guiar e capacitar o time de sustentação nas nuances do desenvolvimento em C/C++ e na administração do ambiente Linux, elevando a maturidade técnica do grupo. Visão Sistêmica e de Arquitetura: Compreensão de como o binário/aplicação interage com o sistema operacional e impacta diretamente os sistemas coligados e as regras de negócio. Comunicação Estratégica e Tradução Técnica: Habilidade de traduzir termos altamente técnicos de baixo nível (como estouro de pilha, vazamento de memória ou gargalo de I/O) em impactos claros para stakeholders e áreas de negócio. Tomada de Decisão sob Pressão: Calma e assertividade para guiar o time técnico no restabelecimento de serviços durante incidentes em produção. Senso de Dono (Ownership): Postura proativa para garantir a estabilidade, segurança e eficiência de recursos (CPU/Memória) do ecossistema SASGC. Negociação e Alinhamento: Capacidade de articular com POs, gerência e outras squads de TI para priorizar correções estruturais contra a urgência de demandas operacionais. title: Chief Financial Officer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Chief Financial Officer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About VelaFi At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States. Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability. Position Overview VelaFi is seeking an experienced Chief Financial Officer (CFO) – Brazil to lead the financial strategy, governance, and regulatory reporting of the company's Brazilian VASP entity. Reporting directly to the Global Finance Leadership Team, the CFO will oversee accounting, treasury, financial planning and analysis (FP&A), tax coordination, regulatory reporting, financial controls, and banking relationships across Brazil. This executive will play a key role in supporting VelaFi's continued expansion by building scalable financial infrastructure, ensuring compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements, and providing strategic financial leadership to the business. The ideal candidate combines deep financial expertise, executive leadership, and experience operating within regulated financial services organizations, with the ability to build scalable processes and support a rapidly growing global fintech company. The CFO will also play a critical role in ensuring compliance with Brazil's financial regulatory reporting framework, including executive oversight of COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, and Unicad (IN BCB 712/713) reporting obligations, while partnering closely with Compliance, Legal, and executive leadership. Location Remote – Brazil Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required. Key Responsibilities Financial Leadership Lead all accounting, finance, treasury, tax, and financial planning activities for the Brazil entity. Develop and execute the company's financial strategy in alignment with global objectives. Establish scalable financial processes, reporting frameworks, and governance standards. Provide financial insights and recommendations to executive leadership. Financial Reporting & Regulatory Compliance Oversee the preparation of accurate financial statements and regulatory reports. Ensure compliance with Brazilian accounting standards, tax requirements, and applicable financial regulations. Lead and oversee all regulatory financial reporting obligations, including COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, and Unicad reporting (IN BCB 712/713), ensuring timely and accurate submissions to BACEN and other applicable regulatory authorities. Support VASP licensing requirements and ongoing regulatory reporting obligations. Coordinate external audits and manage relationships with auditors, the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN), and other regulatory authorities. Maintain strong financial governance while ensuring compliance with evolving regulatory requirements. Treasury & Banking Oversee treasury operations, liquidity management, cash flow forecasting, and banking relationships. Monitor financial performance, capital allocation, and funding requirements. Support payment operations, FX management, and cross-border transaction activities. Partner with Treasury and Operations teams to optimize financial infrastructure. Financial Controls & Risk Management Establish and maintain strong internal controls, accounting policies, and financial governance. Ensure compliance with corporate policies and regulatory requirements. Support enterprise risk management initiatives in partnership with Compliance and Risk leadership. Drive continuous improvement of financial systems and reporting processes. Cross-Functional Leadership Partner closely with Compliance, Operations, Product, Treasury, Legal, Commercial, and Executive Leadership. Support strategic business initiatives, market expansion, and corporate planning. Collaborate with global Finance teams to ensure consistent financial reporting and operational alignment. Organizational Development Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing finance professionals. Build a scalable finance organization capable of supporting rapid business growth. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field. CPA, CRC, or equivalent professional accounting qualification preferred. MBA or advanced finance qualification is a plus. 10+ years of progressive finance leadership experience within fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or related industries. Strong experience leading accounting, treasury, financial reporting, and regulatory compliance functions. Experience working with auditors, regulators, financial institutions, and executive leadership. Strong understanding of Brazilian financial regulations, accounting standards, and tax requirements. Experience preparing or overseeing COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713) reporting, and other regulatory submissions required by Brazilian financial authorities is strongly preferred. Exceptional analytical, leadership, and communication skills. Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English. Desired Competencies Regulatory reporting expertise, including COSIF, SCE-IED, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), and BACEN compliance Nice to Have Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology. Experience with multi-entity and multi-currency financial operations. Experience working with ERP platforms such as NetSuite. Experience supporting regulated financial institutions or VASPs. Knowledge of cross-border payments, FX operations, and treasury infrastructure. Experience working within multinational or global organizations. Hands-on experience with COSIF accounting, SCE-IED reporting, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), and other BACEN regulatory reporting requirements. Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP) Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including: Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil. Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities. Hold any professional registrations or licenses required under Brazilian law to perform the responsibilities of the position, where applicable. Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence. Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws. Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment. Not have been declared bankrupt or legally insolvent. Not have been suspended or prohibited from serving as an executive of regulated financial institutions. Meet any additional "fit and proper" requirements established by the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) and other applicable regulatory authorities. Why Join VelaFi? Joining VelaFi means helping build the next generation of global financial infrastructure. As Chief Financial Officer – Brazil, you will play a foundational role in establishing the financial governance and regulatory reporting framework for one of VelaFi's most strategic international markets. You'll work directly with executive leadership to oversee finance, treasury, regulatory reporting, and compliance while helping build a scalable financial organization that supports the company's long-term growth and Brazil VASP operations. This is an opportunity to shape the financial future of a high-growth fintech company operating at the intersection of traditional finance, digital assets, and cross-border payments. Equal Employment Opportunity VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

title: Portuguese Language Expert
description:

We are looking for detail-oriented Freelance AI Trainers – Audio to support high-impact Generative AI data annotation projects involving PII identification and content risk assessment on raw audio inputs.

In this role, you will listen to and annotate raw audio content to identify personally identifiable information, assess risk signals, evaluate AI-generated outputs where applicable, and apply detailed project guidelines with precision. You will help create high-quality ground truth data used to train and improve advanced AI models.

This is a flexible, freelance engagement suited to individuals who want project-based work rather than a fixed weekly schedule. It requires strong listening comprehension, mature judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment where guidelines may evolve frequently.


Key Responsibilities

As an AI Trainer – Audio, you will:

  • Review and annotate raw audio content, including spoken conversations, calls, and other audio recordings.
  • Identify, classify, and assess personally identifiable information, sensitive data, and privacy-related risks conveyed through audio.
  • Perform risk assessment on audio content involving safety, policy compliance, sensitive topics, and contextual ambiguity.
  • Evaluate AI model outputs derived from audio for correctness, completeness, relevance, risk classification, and guideline adherence, where applicable.
  • Apply complex, frequently updated annotation guidelines consistently and with sound judgment.
  • Handle potentially sensitive, unsafe, or policy-sensitive audio content responsibly and professionally.
  • Manage own schedule and task throughput within agreed project deadlines and quality expectations.
  • Escalate ambiguous cases, guideline gaps, tooling issues, and edge cases to project leads or quality teams.
  • Collaborate remotely with Project Managers, Quality Analysts, and technical teams to improve annotation quality and workflow efficiency.


Required Language Proficiency

Candidates must demonstrate CEFR C1+ equivalent proficiency in their working language (English or the applicable target language). Bilingual proficiency is not required for this role.

Proficiency is required in:

  • Listening / Understanding (primary requirement, given the audio-based nature of the task)
  • Reading comprehension (for guideline interpretation and task instructions)
  • Basic written composition (for annotation notes and escalation of edge cases)

The role requires the ability to understand nuanced spoken language, accents, cultural context, idiomatic expressions, policy-sensitive language, and subtle differences in meaning conveyed through audio.


Required Experience

The ideal candidate should have prior hands-on experience in one or more of the following annotation areas:

  • PII identification or privacy annotation
  • Risk assessment or content safety annotation
  • Audio transcript annotation or audio-based data labeling
  • Named Entity Recognition or entity classification
  • LLM response evaluation
  • AI chatbot evaluation
  • Policy-based content moderation
  • Sensitive content classification
  • Gen AI or LLM training data creation

Candidates must have previously worked on annotation projects requiring strict guideline adherence, ambiguity resolution, and quality-focused decision-making.


Skills and Competencies

We are looking for candidates who have:

  • Excellent listening comprehension and audio interpretation ability in their working language.
  • Strong analytical thinking and decision-making skills.
  • A close attention to detail and consistency.
  • Ability to interpret complex, evolving guidelines and apply them accurately.
  • Comfort working with sensitive, ambiguous, or policy-heavy audio content.
  • Strong understanding of tone, context, and language nuance as conveyed through speech.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote, flexible-hours setup.
  • Familiarity with annotation tools, quality workflows, and productivity tracking.
  • Good communication skills for raising clarifications, documenting edge cases, and collaborating with distributed teams.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree, diploma, or equivalent educational qualification preferred.
  • Minimum 1–2 years of relevant annotation experience in AI/ML, Gen AI, audio data, content moderation, PII, risk assessment, or related domains.
  • Prior experience working on Large Language Model training, evaluation, or data annotation projects is strongly preferred.
  • Exposure to audio-based workflows, trust and safety operations, or privacy-focused annotation will be an advantage.


Engagement Terms

  • This is a freelance, non-binding engagement — there is no guaranteed or fixed weekly hour commitment on either side.
  • Work volume and availability windows will be communicated on a project/task basis, with flexibility for both iMerit and the freelancer to scale up or down.
  • Compensation is structured on a per-hour basis, aligned to project pricing terms, rather than a fixed salary.
  • Freelancers are expected to maintain agreed quality and turnaround standards for the tasks they accept.


What We Offer

  • Flexible, remote freelance opportunity with global project teams.
  • Exposure to cutting-edge Gen AI and LLM data annotation projects.
  • Opportunity to work on meaningful AI safety, privacy, and model improvement initiatives.
  • Structured project guidelines, quality support, and continuous learning opportunities.
  • A collaborative environment focused on precision, accountability, and responsible AI development.


Application Note

This role is suitable for candidates who are highly analytical, quality-focused, and comfortable working with complex audio annotation guidelines on a flexible, freelance basis. Bilingual proficiency is not required. Prior experience in PII, risk assessment, audio annotation, or LLM evaluation is essential.

  • Leading Quality Assurance consultancy company – Our auditors work internationally across different types of organizations and audits and other QA related projects, with top thought-leaders in the industry. We are committed to continuous professional development.
  • Fostering Success in our Auditors - Scheduling to ensure you are able to deliver your best, every time.
  • A Truly Supportive and Management Team – Having a supportive and open leadership team allows our people to show up and be their best.
  • WiZe working schedule - Flexible working schedule to allow you to live your life around work.
  • A Competitive Compensation Package – We believe our people need to be compensated for their dedication.
  • Sustainability – We endeavour to keep auditors travel as local as possible to reduce our carbon footprint in line with our sustainability policy as well as ensuring you have a work/life balance.

Auditors target will be to work to 70% utilisation, which could require up to 50% travel to client sites, that doesn’t mean you’ll be away from home for months at a time, as we ensure we schedule assignments for a fair work/life balance.


Our auditors are deployed to audit Investigator Sites and Vendors, as well as eTMF audits which are done remotely.


You’ll support our clients with Inspection Readiness and Inspection Management related activities across a diverse range of roles and regulatory bodies.


Who We Are

ZigZagQA is a trusted global leader in QA management, offering true global reach and unrivalled expertise to reduce risk and efforts. Working as an extension of our clients team, our experts increase capability and efficiency with collaborative, comprehensive and customized QA programs.


We partners with a wide range of clients across the entire drug discovery and development process to improve GxP Quality against global regulatory standards. We work with top 20 Pharmaceutical and Biotechnology companies, all the way to startups.


We strive for excellence, aiming to be the number one choice for our clients and our employees. We are passionate about Continuous Improvement and are always looking for a ‘better way’.

We are a global, quality leader who put people first and forge lasting relationships to bring deep impact in the industry.

title: Manager - Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting (Capital Markets)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Manager - Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting (Capital Markets) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role

We are seeking a Manager in Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting to join our growing team. This role is ideal for an experienced accounting professional with expertise in IFRS, US GAAP, and technical accounting matters, particularly in advising businesses through reporting and compliance challenges.


The ideal candidate will have experience in Big Four accounting firms, audit, and accounting advisory services , as well as exposure to multiple industries such as manufacturing, infrastructure, SaaS, retail, and professional services. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain high-level advisory experience while working with senior leadership and supporting clients through complex accounting matters.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical accounting advisory services , including IFRS and US GAAP conversions, financial statement preparation, and complex transaction analysis.

  • Support CFOs, Controllers, and Finance teams with regulatory compliance, GAAP conversions, and implementation of new accounting standards.
  • Conduct research on technical accounting issues and provide recommendations for best practices.
  • Assist in M&A transactions by supporting purchase accounting, due diligence, and post-merger financial reporting.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve financial reporting and accounting processes.
  • Mentor and guide junior professionals, ensuring quality service delivery and knowledge sharing.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in accounting advisory, financial reporting, or external audit.
  • Big Four or global advisory firm experience is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS, US GAAP, and other international accounting frameworks .
  • CPA, Chartered Accountant, or equivalent certification is required (or in progress).
  • Exposure to multiple industries (e.G., SaaS, manufacturing, retail, infrastructure) is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects.
  • Excellent communication and client management skills.
  • Bilingual proficiency in Portuguese, Spanish, or English is a plus.

title: Perfusionista
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Perfusionista em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.
  • Graduação completa na área de Saúde;
  • Pós-graduação em Perfusão ou Circulação Extracorpórea;
  • Microsoft Office básico a intermediário;
  • Experiência mínima de 03 anos na função;
  • Conhecimento de Anatomia Humana e Fisiologia do sistema cardíaco;
  • Disponibilidade integral e para viagens.

Diferencial:

  • Desejável CNH categoria B ativa;
  • Desejável possuir veículo (carro) próprio.
  • Participar da implantação de projetos de perfusão;
  • Realizar e validar testes de protótipos;
  • Realizar montagem de materiais descartáveis nos equipamentos de perfusão;
  • Operar máquinas de circulação extracorpórea (CEC), em cirurgias torácicas, cardíacas, de transplante de órgãos e de revascularização periférica, a fim de garantir a manutenção das atividades vitais dos organismos dos pacientes, durante a realização das cirurgias;
  • Operar equipamentos de Oxigenação por Membrana Extracorpórea (ECMO);
  • Controlar a manutenção da função cardiovascular e outras atividades vitais dos organismos dos pacientes (oxigenação do sangue, circulação sanguínea, temperatura corporal, pressão arterial, entre outros), durante os procedimentos;
  • Assegurar o funcionamento adequado dos equipamentos de perfusão, permitindo que os cirurgiões realizem as intervenções necessárias, com segurança;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das normas e procedimentos técnicos de qualidade e de segurança do trabalho;
  • Utilizar técnicas assépticas, para lidar adequadamente com o manuseio de materiais estéreis e biológicos;
  • Zelar pelo estado funcional (guarda, segurança e devolução) dos equipamentos da empresa;
  • Registrar informações dos procedimentos cirúrgicos realizados, em aplicativos/sistemas corporativos, para que as equipes de Assistência de Vendas e Faturamento, possam dar seguimento às etapas internas;
  • Apresentar Comunicados de uso de OPME (fichas de sala), devidamente preenchidos e assinados, para a equipe de Assistência de Vendas, conforme processo interno;
  • Registrar, junto a equipe de Qualidade, Não Conformidades ocorridas em procedimentos, como o mal funcionamento de equipamentos e dispositivos; atrasos, troca de tamanhos e/ou especificidades, etc., conforme processo interno;
  • Realizar a troca de dosímetros digitais e EPIs (quando pertinente), periodicamente e cumprir com as normas de utilização, conforme orientações da equipe de SESMT;
  • Preencher relatórios de controle e outros necessários, conforme solicitação da Gestão.

title: Assistente da qualidade
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Assistente da qualidade em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.
  • Graduação em andamento em Gestão da Qualidade, Administração, Farmácia ou afins;
  • Microsoft Office intermediário, especialmente Word e PowerPoint;
  • Experiência mínima de 1 ano com as funções;
  • Conhecimento básico da Norma ISO 9001, voltada ao Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade;
  • Experiência com o uso de sistemas integrados;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.
  • Desejável conhecimento da Norma RDC 665/2022 ou similares, voltadas a área da saúde;
  • Desejável experiência com o uso de sistemas de gestão da qualidade.
  • Realizar pesquisas de satisfação junto a Clientes e parceiros, tanto presencialmente, quanto por meios telefônicos e/ou digitais;
  • Auxiliar o time, quanto a revisão de Procedimentos da Qualidade, Fluxogramas, Instruções de Trabalho e formulários diversos, junto com os Gestores dos Departamentos;
  • Acompanhar Auditorias Externas de Clientes e Fornecedores (Fabricantes) e órgãos reguladores;
  • Manter a documentação da Qualidade, atualizada, sobretudo a Lista Mestra de Documentos;
  • Identificar Não Conformidades, orientando colaboradores sobre a aplicação correta das normas e procedimentos;
  • Participar da implementação de melhorias nos fluxos e processos;
  • Realizar inspeções das áreas, de acordo com o cronograma estabelecido pela Gestão;
  • Administrar a qualidade dos produtos, armazenados pelo Departamento de Logística, nos estoques, de acordo com a norma RDC 665/2022;
  • Fiscalizar as condições dos produtos, orientando aos colaboradores do Departamento Logística, os processos envolvidos na coleta, recebimento, armazenagem, acondicionamento, expedição e transporte;
  • Monitorar, diariamente, a temperatura e umidade local dos estoques;
  • Analisar e alimentar o relatório mensal, de produtos vencidos e avariados;
  • Verificar o transporte dos produtos, seja por Transportadoras (terceiros) ou transporte próprio (frota da empresa), observando as normas de Boas Práticas, legislações e recomendações dos Fabricantes;
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) quanto a documentos externos (normas, leis, etc.), que são essenciais, para a compreensão dos procedimentos da Qualidade.

title: Operador de perecíveis - boca do rio (4)

Estamos em busca de um Operador de Perecíveis dedicado e proativo para integrar nossa equipe na unidade de Boca do Rio.
